title: CI and the commit gate judge runner/ and chg/ inside the loopctl repo, each only when it changed

story.i_want_to: have the commit gate and CI run runner's and chg's own checks when I touch runner/ or chg/, and skip the server's suite when I touch nothing else
story.so_that: every part of the factory is gated in this repo, and a runner fix does not pay for a full server run

rationale: After US-52.4 and US-52.5 the runner and chg have no CI at all: GitHub runs only the root .github/workflows, loopctl-runner never had a workflow, and chg's ci.yml now sits inert at chg/.github/workflows/ci.yml. The commit gate misses them too: the fleet pre-commit gates only the root mix project when the repo root has a mix.exs (claude-config git-hooks/pre-commit:97-98), so a runner commit runs the server's mix precommit and never the runner's, and a chg commit runs no Rust check. PRD R7 puts CI capacity at its budget ceiling, so each part runs its checks only when its paths changed.

acceptance_criteria.description: .github/scripts/changed-areas.sh <base> <head> prints, one per line and sorted, the areas the diff touches: runner for runner/** or priv/runner_contract/**, chg for chg/**, e2e for e2e/**, server for every other path; release/** and .github/** count as every area.

.github/workflows/runner-ci.yml runs on push to master and epic/** and on pull_request to master; its runner job (runs-on [self-hosted, fleet-ci], working-directory runner) runs compile --warnings-as-errors, deps.unlock --check-unused, format --check-formatted, credo --strict, dialyzer and test, and is skipped by its if: when changed-areas.sh does not print runner.

.github/workflows/chg-ci.yml carries every job of chg's ci.yml (rust on linux and the macos leg, volume-setup, elixir-adapter, typescript-adapter, generic-adapter with loop-test and replay-selection-test) with working directories under chg/, on the same runner labels, skipped when changed-areas.sh does not print chg; chg/.github/ is deleted.

Every job of .github/workflows/ci.yml except deploy and smoke is skipped by its if: when changed-areas.sh prints no server area, and runs exactly as today when it prints server; deploy runs on every master push in which no job failed or was cancelled, a job skipped by area included, so every green merge to master deploys whatever area it touched.
No job in runner-ci.yml or chg-ci.yml runs on a GitHub-hosted runner: every runs-on resolves to [self-hosted, fleet-ci] or the CI_RUNNER_MACOS repository variable, never ubuntu-latest or macos-*.

.githooks/pre-commit runs mix precommit in runner/ when a staged path is under runner/, and runs cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked in chg/ when a staged path is under chg/ outside chg/adapters/; a failing check stops the commit with the area named.

.githooks/pre-commit runs mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix test in chg/adapters/elixir when a staged path is under it, and node --test test/unit.test.mjs test/integration.test.mjs in chg/adapters/typescript when a staged path is under that one.

.githooks/pre-commit hands to the fleet hook ($HOME/.git-hooks/pre-commit) only when a staged path lies outside runner/, chg/ and e2e/; a commit staging only runner/ or chg/ paths never runs the root mix precommit.

test_cases.name: changed-areas classification (ExUnit, shell under test)
preconditions: a temp repo with commits touching runner/lib/x.ex; priv/runner_contract/v1.json; chg/cli/src/x.rs; lib/x.ex; release/manifest.toml; e2e/test/x.exs
steps: run changed-areas.sh for each single-commit range
for a range touching runner/ and lib/
expected_results: runner; runner; chg; server; chg e2e runner server; e2e; runner server

test_cases.name: workflow shape guard (ExUnit reading YAML with yaml_elixir)
steps: for each job, read runs-on, if and working-directory
expected_results: runner and chg jobs gated on their area and on fleet-ci or CI_RUNNER_MACOS; every ci.yml job but deploy and smoke gated on the server area; deploy's if: admits skipped needs and refuses failed or cancelled ones; no ubuntu-latest in the two new files; chg/.github absent

test_cases.name: the commit gate routes by staged area (ExUnit, shell under test)
preconditions: a temp clone with .githooks/pre-commit; PATH stubs for mix, cargo and a fake $HOME/.git-hooks/pre-commit that each append their argv and cwd to a log and exit with a configured code
steps: stage runner/lib/x.ex with the stub mix failing
expected_results: runner/ mix precommit only; the three cargo calls in chg/ only; the fleet hook and runner precommit; non-zero exit naming runner

test_cases.name: adapter areas run their own checks (ExUnit, shell under test)
preconditions: as TC-52.6.3, plus a node stub
expected_results: the three mix calls in chg/adapters/elixir; node --test in chg/adapters/typescript; no cargo call for either

technical_notes: chg's workflow to port: /home/mkreyman/workspace/chg/.github/workflows/ci.yml (jobs rust :30-90, volume-setup :92-127, elixir-adapter :128-200, typescript-adapter :201-262, generic-adapter :263-283). Its scripts are referenced as scripts/ci-rust-toolchain.sh and bin/chg-volume-setup.sh from the chg root; under chg/ they are chg/scripts/... with working-directory: chg. The macos leg reads vars.CI_RUNNER_MACOS (:43); set the same repository variable on mkreyman/loopctl (definition_of_done). chg/.github/workflows/release.yml is replaced by US-52.7; chg/.github/workflows/pr-body.yml is not ported (defaults).

loopctl ci.yml: triggers :3-30, concurrency :43-45, jobs from :133 (lint :134, test :304, retrieval-eval :514, security :745, dialyzer :835, scale-test :930, pgbouncer-e2e :1129, scale-nightly :1273, smoke-preflight :1621, deploy :1655 with needs at :1661, smoke :1673). Add one changes job that runs changed-areas.sh against github.event.before (push) or the PR base and exposes server/runner/chg/e2e outputs; every gated job needs it. A first push of a new branch (before = 0000...) counts as every area.

A job skipped by its if: reports as skipped, which branch protection accepts for a required check; a workflow skipped by on.paths would leave the check pending, which is why no workflow here uses paths filters. The scheduled 02:00 run (ci.yml:16) counts as every area.

Workflow guard tests already read ci.yml (test/loopctl/ci_scale_nightly_cron_test.exs, test/loopctl/ci_warnings_as_errors_test.exs); the new guard goes beside them as test/loopctl/factory_ci_workflows_test.exs. YAML parsing: yaml_elixir is a dependency (mix.exs:193).

Commit gate: .githooks/pre-commit today only execs $HOME/.git-hooks/pre-commit (the fleet hook), which gates the root project alone when $ROOT/mix.exs exists (claude-config git-hooks/pre-commit:97-108). .githooks/install.sh points core.hooksPath at the dispatcher that runs this file. Staged paths come from git diff --cached --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMRD, NUL-safe, as the fleet hook reads them.
The shell tests follow test/loopctl/githooks_pre_push_test.exs: async: true, a temp repo per case, stubs on PATH, no network.
No new table, context, route or tool.

Deploy: a job whose needs were skipped is itself skipped by default, so deploy's if: (ci.yml:1662) becomes always() && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' && !contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') && !contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled'); its needs list (:1661) gains changes, so a change set that could not be judged never deploys, and smoke's if: becomes always() && needs.deploy.result == 'success' (a skip anywhere above it would otherwise skip it). chg's cargo-cache actions move to .github/actions with a dir input (default chg), and every runner-ci/chg-ci checkout is clean: false plus .github/scripts/clean-workspace.sh, ci.yml's clean, so a chg or runner job never deletes the root _build the server jobs keep warm. Every green merge to master deploys (KB 4d3fd7bb); only the checks are skipped by area.
non_goals: The release tag and the chg artifact build: US-52.7.
CI for e2e/ (its compile and lint job, and the nightly run): US-52.9.
Moving the fleet pre-commit itself into this repo: release 8 (README release block 52.50-52.55).

failure_modes.partition: n/a: CI jobs and the hook run on one machine against its checkout; nothing here is a call to another service.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.6.1: which areas a change touches is computed from the diff on every run and stored nowhere.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.6.1: a re-run of a workflow or a re-tried commit computes the same areas from the same diff and runs the same checks.
failure_modes.slow: n/a: each job keeps the timeout-minutes its source workflow had; nothing new waits on a network.
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.6.5: every job runs on the fleet-ci pool or the macOS variable's runner, the runners loopctl's CI already uses.

defaults: chg's pr-body.yml check is not ported: loopctl's master has no pr-body check today, and adding one would gate every server PR (owner may add it repo-wide).
The runner and chg job names (runner, rust (linux), elixir-adapter, typescript-adapter, generic-adapter) are added to master's required status checks (owner may trim).
definition_of_done: gh api repos/mkreyman/loopctl/branches/master/protection/required_status_checks --jq .contexts lists the runner and chg job names; gh variable list -R mkreyman/loopctl shows CI_RUNNER_MACOS.
On the epic branch, a push touching only runner/ shows the runner job green and every ci.yml job but changes skipped (gh run view).
On master after the epic merges, a merge touching only runner/ shows the server jobs skipped and Deploy succeeded (gh run view).
